checks.name: dispatch_and_guard_precedence
checks.finding: Population precedes Reception, RootedLine, Panel, Chamber and Exposed. Presence of its plan key selects its own guard; null, false or empty plans do not bypass it.

checks.name: candidate_binding
checks.finding: Own population points follow inherited candidates; the common envelope measures and binds their current public support and rejects a changed point.

checks.name: single_acquisition_and_event_routing
checks.finding: Own acquisition occurs once after Reception and before public packet acquisition. Only observed_reference_population events replay into the Population owner.

checks.name: conditional_digest_compatibility
checks.finding: The new digest suffix follows Reception and enters only after an own event. Eight published 0.46 checkpoint cases cover empty and nonempty earlier layers.

checks.name: atomic_restoration
checks.finding: Replay builds temporary owners and checks the complete digest before publication. Rejected restores preserve the existing owner identities and state.

checks.name: working_certificate
checks.finding: Population identity, native revision and structural witness participate in certified reuse; reducer changes, replacement and direct working-state or journal edits invalidate reuse.

checks.name: detached_ownership
checks.finding: Public state, proposed state and returned events remain detached from the retained owner; retained event ownership supports safe repeated native restoration.

checks.name: native_limits
checks.finding: The common entry enforces positive remaining actions, a current deadline and a capped prefix. Population paths and matching share native work bounds whose exhaustion returns blocking unknown without acquisition.

checks.name: cold_source_chain
checks.finding: The integration test now follows two coherent cold source acquisitions and compares their complete own events, then restores the acquired selection and displacement before the next decision.

checks.name: qualified_coverage
checks.finding: The six declared observed branches are registered and the entry count is 51/76. The common source module remains partial_transfer, fullV6Parity is false and all six completion gates remain false.
